heading: DSP Pension Fund NPS Review: Returns, Portfolio & Fees (2026)
tldr: DSP Pension Fund is a relatively new player among the National Pension System (NPS) fund managers.
As of early 2026, it has shown lower 1-year equity returns compared to its peers in the NPS.
The fund's portfolio strategy leans towards a higher allocation in AA-rated corporate bonds.
NPS offers tax benefits under Sections 80C, 80CCD(1B), and 80CCD(2) of the Income Tax Act, 1961.
Choosing a Pension Fund Manager (PFM) involves evaluating their long-term performance, investment philosophy, and alignment with your risk profile.
